headline: Know which rooms are ready instantly
body: Your front desk sees room status updates the moment housekeeping finishes. No internal phone calls. Faster check-ins.
caption:
Guests are waiting in your lobby after a long safari. Your front desk team is calling housekeeping to check if room 204 is ready.

With Operra, the moment housekeeping updates a room's status, the front desk sees it instantly. No internal phone calls. No manual checks. Just faster check-ins.
